description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the length of a gold prefix and BLEU scores for consistency and inconsistency. The x-axis is labeled “the length of gold prefix,” has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU,” has a linear scale, ranges from 23 to 29, and has tick labels at integer values. A blue dashed line with circle markers represents “Consistency: wait-1”, starting at a value of approximately 24.4 at x=0, declining to 23.4 at x=1, then generally increasing to 28.6 at x=20 with fluctuations along the way, for example reaching 27.2 at x=15. A red dashed line with square markers represents “Inconsistency: wait-9”, starting at a value of approximately 25.3 at x=0, fluctuating between approximately 25 and 26.4, then declines to 25.1 at x=20.
